TEXT:
In the end, we ended up going to the usual 
electronics store. It's not like I didn't want to, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Wha... that pen tablet has dropped in price... If only 
we waited a bit longer.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
But if we did wait, you wouldn't have made the 
deadline, right?

With that exchange, we browsed around the 
electronics store...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: This... doesn't feel like how a date should be.

As we returned to the train station, I muttered that 
complaint.

I mean, it wasn't very different from what we 
would normally do with Saori and gang, so now 
with just Kuroneko herself...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, Kuro-

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN
TEXT: Um, excuse me. Do you have a second?

Unfortunately, a lady with a survey had caught 
hold of Kuroneko at the train station.

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN
TEXT:
Excuse me! If you have the time, can you help me 
fill out a very simple survey...

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN
TEXT:
If you two were to go on vacation, where would 
you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Ah, no... I...

Usually this wouldn't be a problem, but Kuroneko 
cast her eyes down.
As I thought, something's not right with her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Excuse me. If I could?

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN
TEXT: Yes, what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Ah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Thanks.

The cause of that behavior if I had to guess... 
nature calls.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Thanks for waiting.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Oh, welcome back. If you needed to go, you 
should've just went.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
What are you going on about? I was just calling 
Hinata and Tamaki, also...

Putting away your handkerchief while you say that 
isn't very convincing, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You went to the toilet, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Didn't I tell you otherwise? I'll curse you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...No, that was a lie. I'm sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
To be honest, I had been holding it ever since we 
left the cafe...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It would've been better if you just told me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But, it's embarrassing... and I was nervous...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You mean, because you're with me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Of course! I mean, this is our first date...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: D-Don't say something so embarrassing...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: A-Aren't you the one who made me say it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...That's right. It's my fault.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: R-Right now... um...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I'm... going to go flower picking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I see. That strange behavior of hers... It seems like 
she needed to go to the toilet.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Thanks for waiting.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, welcome back.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Well, I suppose it was pointless to expect you to be 
considerate...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Uh, Kuroneko-san? Why have you become so angry 
with me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Touch your heart and ask yourself that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Uhh, so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...You could have helped when that survey lady got 
involved with me earlier.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Oh no, that was impossible. It's not like I have some 
supernatural power.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
You're up to the task. If your dormant powers 
within were to be awoken...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's impossible, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...Looks like it will take quite some time for your 
awakening.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
So, where shall we go next? This time, I'll 
accompany you wherever you want to go.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That's fine and all but, what happened to those 
nerves from a first date?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
It's mostly gone now, thanks to what happened 
earlier.

As Kuroneko said that, we walked towards the 
department stores. It's starting to feel like a normal 
date now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Okay, let's go check out some CDs.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Is there something you have in mind?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well no, but... Feels like it would be more 
appropriate for a date.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: W-We might as well then...

And with that simple train of thought, we arrived at 
the CD shop, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...I don't understand this at all. What kind of albums 
are popular nowadays?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Even if you asked me, I wouldn't know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I know the titles for J-POP but... Western music and 
the likes are beyond me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: If it were Anisong...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Ah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm? Kuroneko?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: This still remains here, it seems.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What did you find?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: A "Maschera" Season 1 DVD box-set.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah...

Probably leftover stock. It even has a 50% off 
sticker.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
It's alright. You don't have to say anything. But it's 
not like us fans have abandoned our hopes for a 
sequel.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: R-Really.

She's completely different from earlier, she's fully in 
her element now. Once again, we're back to how 
we usually act around each other.
